resolution: Geng Su had a wasting chest for a year and hid it to keep his post. Du Heng treated him with the western resin. When it eased his breathing he went himself before dawn to the camel men past the tanners to buy more, and came back wet from the marsh ground with a jar.
summary: Geng Su's last two months: thin, off his horse, out of the ward before dawn five or six times, back wet to the ankle and once carrying something heavy.
